evaluation_partition: report partition of the locked three-way validation split; reserved test data never loaded

ciciot.provenance: byte-equivalent to a third-party release; official UNB provenance unverified

metric_rules.detection_new_runs: corrected single decision rule (src/metrics.py), read from final_validation_metrics.json
metric_rules.detection_reused_runs: audited ledger Phase9_Manuscript_Revision/ledger/ledger_per_run_phase6c.csv (original F1/AUC/FPR corrected for the threshold/tie defect); AP from the original run output (not audited)
metric_rules.network: network_metrics.csv over selected transfers (delay and transfer efficiency over delivered updates; PDR, delivery rate, path stability over all selected transfers)
metric_rules.bytes: update_bytes (attempted = all selected; delivered = update_delivered only) and bytes_on_wire from network_metrics.csv

table_trace: every number in TABLE4_V2_FINAL_TABLE.tex is mean (SD) of a column of TABLE4_V2_PER_SEED.csv over the five seeds of one (dataset, arm); every per-seed row carries run_id, out_dir, config_sha256, code_fingerprint and manifest_sha256, and is listed here with the hashes of its source files

robust_random_no_imputation.label: MAD filter, uniform selection, routed paths

t4_e2_robust_random_path.label: MAD filter, uniform selection, random paths (E2)
